statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail sits in the low band at 17% while Stress stays elevated at 48% ahead of the US macro block on September quadruple-witching expiry.
recommendation: Observed structure is a two-hour stall: the 29,966.75 session high has not been retaken and NQ has faded about 100 points off it and held, so the retracement mechanism is functioning and Tail remains well below the block threshold. Conditional risk is concentrated in the 13:15Z-15:00Z window, where August Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the US cash open coincide on expiry day, with a secondary Stress peak at the 20:00Z settlement.
headline: NQ holds about +0.4% near 29,860 with the 29,966.75 high unretaken for two hours, as Brent slips toward $103, the 10-year eases to 4.947% and VIX sits at 15.34 into quadruple-witching expiry
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73% (+501.92 points), in a relief rally after Wednesday's unanimous 12-0 Federal Reserve decision to raise the target range to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than three years, with a further hike signalled before year-end. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% on a 7-2 vote, a 31-year high. The yen has weakened rather than strengthened since: USD/JPY trades at 157.97, up 1.29% and near the top of its 155.864-158.054 daily range. A weaker yen after a hike is the opposite of a carry unwind, so the transmission channel that makes a central-bank second leg dangerous for mean-reversion strategies is not active. NQ December futures trade between 29,860.50 and 29,866.75 on two independent quotes, about +0.4% against a 29,743.00 previous close. The 29,966.75 session high has now stood unretaken for roughly two hours and price has faded about 100 points off it and held, which is retracement behaviour rather than one-way extension. Cross-assets point the same way: VIX 15.34 sits near the bottom of its 14.99-15.36 range, the 10-year yield has eased 5.9bp to 4.947% and the 5-year 5.8bp to 4.801%, and crude is in a third consecutive down session with WTI near 101.1 (-0.8%) and Brent near 103.0 after Saudi Arabia moved to restore roughly half of its damaged East-West pipeline capacity and reroute cargoes through Hormuz and Oman. Falling yields alongside rising equities is a divergence, not the aligned amplifier stack a pathological path requires. The unresolved element is geopolitical: three pumping stations on the Saudi East-West pipeline are damaged and fresh Saudi-Houthi cross-border exchanges were reported Thursday, which keeps a floor under Stress even while its market transmission is currently lower oil. Today is September quadruple-witching expiry, so index-level flow is concentrated into the 13:30Z cash open and the 20:00Z settlement. Shared Finviz cross-asset context was collected at 06:43Z with a partial status and its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it is treated here only as delayed latest-session background: its breadth reading showed a broad prior-session advance led by semiconductors, which supports the trend-up label but is explicitly not evidence of live structure. Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with Tail in the low band at 17% and Stress elevated at 48%.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 62% to the low 40s before ticking back toward 50% around the Bank of Japan decision. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced; Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared. From 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence near 87%, and that regime held through the BOJ statement and the Ueda press conference without a disorderly repricing. The 07:00Z through 09:00Z hours returned to a trend-up read as NQ pressed the top of its band, and price has since stalled and faded back from that high.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry one narrow conditional-risk peak. Tail holds at 17% through the European late morning, rises to 19% at 11:00Z as US pre-market positioning builds for quadruple-witching expiry and enters the watch band at 12:00Z. It reaches 23% at 13:00Z, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the cash open coincide, and the single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 14:00Z at Tail 25%, covering the window in which opening continuation is confirmed or rejected. Tail then eases through the US afternoon and returns to the watch band into the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement, where Stress peaks at 58%. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 11-14% and Confidence decays into the solid band across the remaining weekend slots.
